headline: One lane per game holds: slot a yields the Contra voice stage to slot b
lede: Two builder lanes raced the same empty-board never-dry kick at the same tick and both named Contra's voice gap. The older claim wins: slot a closed its duplicate with the probe evidence attached and left slot b's live build untouched.

notes.text: Never-dry dup-race: the kick names a game at warden-tick time, not file time — forge-claim guards one-issue-two-lanes but not one-game-two-issues. Re-enumerate `building` before filing a never-dry POLISH and yield to the older claim (#3000 vs #3001).

Probes (fake-mic + relaysim) prove Contra's consented take already opens the mic at seed-birth (`__autoCapture.voice === true`); the real missing piece is the voiceCmd channel — slot b's #3000 now owns it, with flush/slot-honesty gotchas relayed on the issue.
Iron Keep's pause-overlay and gamepad legs went red on the noon CI (advisory) while the full nightly passed at tip — load-sensitive family; file for QA only if it fails again at tip.
idle-kick now honestly answers NONE with Contra held: every gap on every unheld title is owned. STOP is legal while #3000 builds.
